blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: lossless — Original data can be reconstructed exactly.
lossy — Some original information is deliberately discarded.
compression ratio — Original size divided by compressed size (by this convention).

blocks.title: Find redundant data
blocks.text: Repeated patterns and predictable structures can be encoded efficiently.

blocks.title: Choose method
blocks.text: Lossless retains all detail; lossy permits irreversible approximation.
